# graphiant_ipsec_profiles (Data Source)

Global IPsec profiles and how many gateway configs currently reference each one, used by graphiant_gateway's ipsec_gateway.vpn_profile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_ipsec_profiles" "all" {}
```
